units.source_text: 可能是因為這個緣故吧，研究會死氣沉沉的氣氛漸漸變得愉快輕鬆，而我也成了聚會中很有人氣的人。

en.t: Perhaps because of that, the gloomy atmosphere of the study group gradually became cheerful and relaxed, and I too became a popular person at the gatherings.

units.source_text: 這些貌似單純的人們，或許以為我和他們一樣單純，

en.t: These seemingly simple people probably thought that I was as simple as they were,

units.source_text: 是一個樂天派愛搞笑的「同志」。

en.t: that I was an optimistic, joke-loving comrade.

units.source_text: 果真如此的話，那我可是徹頭徹尾地欺騙了他們。

en.t: If that was truly the case, then I had deceived them completely from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 可我逢聚會必到，為大家提供搞笑服務。

en.t: Even so, I attended every gathering and provided everyone with comic entertainment.

units.source_text: 因為我喜歡這樣做，喜歡這些人，

en.t: It was because I liked doing that, and because I liked those people,

units.source_text: 但未必是因為馬克思而建立起來的親密感。

en.t: but it was not necessarily an intimacy formed through Marx.

units.source_text: 非法，帶給我小小的樂趣，莫如說它使我心曠神怡。

en.t: Illegality gave me a small pleasure; rather, it made me feel refreshed and at ease.
